info.name: Auth System API v1
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing all Auth System API endpoints.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer authentication. Use the Login endpoint first to obtain tokens.

## Variables
- `baseUrl`: API base URL (default: http://localhost:5000)
- `accessToken`: JWT access token (auto-set after login)
- `refreshToken`: Refresh token (auto-set after login)
- `userId`: Current user ID (auto-set after login)

## Argon2id Hashing
All secrets, tokens, and API keys are hashed using Argon2id algorithm.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Core authentication endpoints: login, logout, token refresh, password management

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns JWT access token and refresh token.

Password is verified using Argon2id hashing.

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token.

Refresh token is looked up using Argon2id hash.
Logs out the current device by revoking the refresh token and blacklisting the access token.
Logs out from all devices by revoking all refresh tokens for the user.

Changes the authenticated user's password.

Password history is checked to prevent reuse. Both old and new passwords are hashed with Argon2id.

Initiates password reset flow by generating a reset token.

The token is hashed with Argon2id before storage. In production, the token would be sent via email.

Resets password using a valid reset token.

Requires email for efficient token lookup. Token is verified using Argon2id VerifyPassword pattern (same as login). All existing sessions are terminated by default.
Returns information about the currently authenticated user from the JWT claims.

Revokes a token (access or refresh).

TokenTypeHint can be 'access_token' or 'refresh_token'.

Introspects a token to check if it's active and retrieve its claims.

Returns token metadata including expiration, subject, roles, and permissions.

Sends a 6-digit OTP to the authenticated user's email for verification.

Requires authentication. OTP expires in 15 minutes.
Rate limited to 3 requests per 60 seconds.

OTP is hashed with Argon2id before storage.

Verifies a user's email using the 6-digit OTP sent to their email.

OTP is verified using Argon2id hash comparison.
Max 5 attempts per OTP. After 5 failed attempts, a new OTP must be requested.

Resends the email verification OTP to the specified email address.

Can be used when user hasn't received the OTP or it has expired.
Rate limited to 3 requests per 60 seconds per email.

Returns same response for valid/invalid emails to prevent enumeration.

item.name: Sessions

request.description: Returns list of active sessions for the authenticated user.

item.name: Two-Factor Authentication
item.description: 2FA setup and management using TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password)

request.description:
Initiates 2FA setup and returns the secret and QR code URI.

The secret should be added to an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.).

Enables 2FA by verifying a TOTP code from the authenticator app.

Returns backup recovery codes. Recovery codes are hashed with Argon2id before storage.

Disables 2FA by verifying a valid TOTP code.

Requires a valid code to prevent unauthorized disabling.

item.name: Audit Logs
item.description: Audit log query endpoints (requires auditlogs:* permissions)

request.description:
Returns paginated list of audit logs with optional filtering.

Filters available:
- action: Filter by action type (e.g., 'Login', 'Create', 'Update', 'Delete')
- entityType: Filter by entity type (e.g., 'User', 'Role', 'Permission')
- startDate/endDate: Filter by date range

Requires 'auth:audit:read' permission.

Returns a specific audit log entry by ID.

Requires 'auth:audit:read' permission.

Returns all audit logs for a specific user.

Requires 'auth:audit:read' permission.

Returns all audit logs for a specific entity.

Entity types: User, Role, Permission, Organization, Application, ApiKey

Requires 'auth:audit:read' permission.

Exports audit logs in specified format (CSV or JSON).

Requires 'auth:audit:export' permission.

item.name: API Keys
item.description: API key management for application authentication (requires apikeys:* permissions)

request.description:
Returns all API keys for an application.

Requires 'auth:apikeys:read' permission.

exec: // Note: The apiKey value is only shown once!
console.log("API Key (save this - only shown once!):", jsonData.apiKey);

body.raw:
{
    "applicationId": "{{applicationId}}",
    "name": "Test API Key",
    "description": "API key for testing",
    "environment": "development",
    "rateLimitPerMinute": 100,
    "rateLimitPerDay": 10000,
    "expiresAt": null,
    "permissionIds": []
}

request.description:
Creates a new API key.

The API key is hashed with Argon2id before storage. The plain key is only returned once!

Requires 'auth:apikeys:create' permission.

Revokes an API key, immediately invalidating it.

Requires 'auth:apikeys:revoke' permission.

Rotates an API key, generating a new one while keeping the old one valid for a grace period.

The new API key is hashed with Argon2id. The plain key is only returned once!

Requires 'auth:apikeys:rotate' permission.

item.name: Organizations
item.description: Multi-tenant organization management endpoints for managing organizations, members, invitations, app subscriptions, and permissions

item.name: Organization CRUD
item.description: Create, read, update, and delete organizations

request.description:
Returns all organizations the current user is a member of.

Authenticated users can see their own organizations.

body.raw:
{
    "code": "acme-corp",
    "name": "Acme Corporation",
    "description": "A sample organization for testing",
    "contactEmail": "admin@acme.com",
    "website": "https://acme.com",
    "logoUrl": null
}

request.description:
Creates a new organization. The authenticated user becomes the organization owner.

Code must be unique (slug format, lowercase, hyphens allowed).

Returns detailed information about a specific organization.

Requires membership in the organization.

Updates an organization's details.

Requires 'org:update' permission or org-owner/org-admin role.

Deletes an organization (soft delete).

Requires 'org:delete' permission (typically org-owner only).

exec: // Find a member that is not the current user for testing

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of organization members.

Requires 'org:members:read' permission.

Updates a member's organization-level role (e.g., org-admin, org-member).

Requires 'org:members:manage' permission.
Cannot change the owner's role.

Removes a member from the organization.

Requires 'org:members:manage' permission.
Cannot remove the organization owner.

Returns all pending invitations for an organization.

Requires 'org:members:read' permission.

Sends an invitation to join the organization.

Requires 'org:members:invite' permission.
The invitation token is returned (in dev/test environments) and also sent via email in production.

Accepts an organization invitation.

Requires authentication. The invitation must not be expired and must not already be accepted/declined.

Returns all applications enabled for this organization.

Requires 'org:apps:read' permission.

Enables an application for the organization (creates a subscription).

Requires 'org:apps:manage' permission.
Members can then be granted access to this app.

Can change subscription tier, expiration date, or active status.

Requires 'org:apps:manage' permission.

Disables an application for the organization (removes the subscription).

Requires 'org:apps:manage' permission.

item.name: Member App Roles
item.description: Assign application-level roles to members within the organization

request.description:
Assigns an application-level role to a member.

Example: Assign "Data Transfer Editor" role which bundles multiple permissions.

Requires 'org:members:manage' permission.
The app must be enabled for the organization.

item.name: Member Permissions
item.description: Grant individual permissions to members within the organization

request.description:
Grants a specific permission to a member for an application.

Use this for granular control when roles are too broad.
For example: Grant only 'data-transfer:export' without full editor access.

Requires 'org:members:manage' permission.
The app must be enabled for the organization.
Basic health check endpoint.
